blocks.text: More than a thousand government transactions were recorded during the Grand Ease of Doing Business (EODB) Fair at SM City North EDSA on October 19–20, as ARTA and SM Supermalls brought 28 participating government agencies together in one location. The two-day event, organized by the Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA) in partnership with SM Supermalls, was held at the fourth floor of the Annex Building and brought government service counters together in one location. Measured service, meaningful access Visitors could seek NBI clearance processing, National ID registration and assistance, PhilHealth and SSS membership services, Pag-IBIG inquiries, driver’s license renewals subject to eligibility, […]...
